title: Content model files under source control
description: Document types, data types, and templates serialized to files (for example by a synchronization package or a deployment tool), instead of living only in the database.

impact.summary: Content model files can make content-transfer paths viable; they must match the version of the tool used for the target.

handling.option: Use the files with a content-transfer tool whose support for the exact source and target is verified
handling.when: The tool documents support for the source and target

handling.option: Treat the database as the source of truth and keep the files in sync after the migration

checks.text: Content model files are regenerated or confirmed in sync after the database step
